details:
Given that physbone interactions are trackable via OSC, many integrations have been created over the past few years that allow for advanced interactions between players.

However, the ability to limit this access I feel is sorely needed! At the moment, the only way you can filter these interactions is by having the physbone itself activate based on if someone is on your friendslist or just allow anyone with access in safety settings to access.

However, if the UID or Uname was passed along in the message containing the info with the physbone, then these third party integratons can setup permission levels without requiring additional permission roles to be added into VRC game UI!

being able to have a permission system for systems like OSCLeash, allowing only certain individuals to interact with such things without having to prevent everyone except those select few from interacting with your physbones at all, as a prime example, would be incredible, and is honestly the inspiration for this, as I'd love to use that system but I dont want EVERYONE to be able to use it, just certain individuals!

But at the moment, I either have to be subject to EVERYONE or FRIENDS ONLY or NOONE. and as someone who has a lot of people on my contacts list for being able to access music events, I do not feel safe allowing that level of control to be granted to my entire contacts list!

Thanks for your consideration.
title: add userid or username of entity interacting with physbone to OSC output
